description: This Java class implements a command strategy for updating loan interest pauses via external IDs within the Fineract project. It handles parsing URL path parameters, deserializing request bodies, invoking the API resource to perform updates, and serializing the response.

classes.name: UpdateLoanInterestPauseByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to handle updates of loan interest pauses using external identifiers. It parses URL path elements, deserializes request payloads, delegates the update to the API resource, and serializes the result into a BatchResponse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the update operation for loan interest pause based on URL parameters and request body, returning a BatchResponse with the status and result.
